national_news.title: FM Sitharaman Reaffirms India's Growth Focus at New York Business Roundtable
bullets: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman addressed a high-level business roundtable in New York, organized by the Consulate General of India and Bank of America, showcasing India's reform-driven growth.
Highlighted key economic reforms including the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC) aimed at improving regulatory certainty, easing compliance, and reducing paperwork.
Emphasized strategic government priorities such as artificial intelligence, data centers, Global Capability Centers (GCCs), credit delivery to MSMEs, and reducing bank non-performing assets (NPAs).

national_news.title: PM Modi Calls for Urban Water Planning at National Departmental Summit on Water
bullets: PM Narendra Modi addressed the valedictory session of the two-day National Departmental Summit on Water organized by the Ministry of Jal Shakti.
Advocated holding 'Chintan Shivirs' for Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) and promoting 'Jal Utsav' to drive public participation (Jan Bhagidari) in water management.
Key recommendations included standardized SOPs for regular de-silting, dam safety preparedness prior to monsoons, and adopting AI for centralized water data governance.

national_news.title: NHPC Prepared to Begin Execution of 1,856 MW Sawalkot Hydropower Project in J&K
bullets: NHPC is set to execute the 1,856 MW Sawalkot Hydroelectric Project in Ramban district, Jammu & Kashmir, pending final clearances from the Public Investment Board (PIB) and the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA).

Located in the Chenab basin, the project is a major component of India's strategic push to maximize the utilization of Western Rivers (Indus, Jhelum, Chenab) under the 1960 Indus Waters Treaty framework.
The infrastructure project spans Ramban, Udhampur, and Reasi districts, requiring 1,401.35 hectares of land, with Ramban accounting for nearly 89% of the total submergence area.

national_news.title: India and Belgium Agree to Deepen Defence Cooperation and Maritime Security Ties
bullets: Union Defence Minister Rajnath Singh held bilateral talks with Belgium's Defence and Foreign Trade Minister Theo Francken in New Delhi to review defence and industrial collaboration.
Both nations agreed to expand ties through defence cooperation dialogues, joint military training, capacity building, and enhanced maritime security collaboration in the Indo-Pacific region.
The defence meeting was held alongside high-level bilateral discussions between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever.

national_news.title: Defence Minister Unveils 'RAKSHA' Strategic Framework for Defence Diplomacy
bullets: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh launched 'RAKSHA', a comprehensive defence diplomacy document setting out India's strategic 10-year roadmap for global defence partnerships.
The blueprint focuses on four key pillars: strategic partnerships, military capacity building, indigenous defence exports under 'Make-in-India', and maritime security.
The policy reinforces India's operational role as a Net Security Provider and First Responder in the Indian Ocean Region (IOR) to foster long-term global stability.

national_news.title: 18th BRICS Intellectual Property Heads Meeting Held in New Delhi
bullets: The 18th Meeting of the Heads of IP Offices of BRICS Countries was hosted in New Delhi by the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (CGPDTM) under DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry.
Aligned with India's BRICS Chairship theme, 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability', the meeting adopted Updated Operational Guidelines to align global IP standards.
Delegates agreed on protection frameworks for traditional knowledge systems, patent analytics for Geographical Indications (GIs), and establishing the IP BRICS FinTech Innovation Monitor.

national_news.title: Prime Minister Narendra Modi holds bilateral talks with Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever in New Delhi
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi held bilateral talks with Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever during his three-day visit to India.
Discussions focused on trade and investment, defence and security, renewable energy, and regional and global issues of mutual interest.
Bilateral trade reached over 13 billion dollars in 2025-26, and FDI inflows from Belgium stood at approximately 4.2 billion dollars between April 2000 and December 2025.

national_news.title: Japan Credit Rating Agency upgrades India's sovereign credit rating to 'A-' with Stable Outlook
bullets: Japan Credit Rating Agency (JCR) upgraded India’s Long-Term Foreign Currency and Local Currency Issuer Ratings from 'BBB+' to 'A-' with a Stable Outlook.
The upgrade reflects India's solid economic growth, effective policy implementation, improved fiscal quality, and enhanced soundness of the financial system.
JCR noted the Central Government's fiscal deficit declined from 4.7 percent in FY25 to 4.4 percent in FY26 while maintaining high capital expenditure.

national_news.title: Retd Air Marshal Jeetendra Mishra Appointed as First CEO of Shri Ram Janmbhoomi Kshetra Trust
bullets: Former Commander of Western Air Command, Retired Air Marshal Jeetendra Mishra, was appointed as the first CEO of Shri Ram Janmbhoomi Kshetra Trust in Ayodhya.
The selection was made by a three-member search committee headed by retired Justice Pramod Kohli to oversee administrative and operational functions of the temple complex.
Mishra played a key role in Operation Sindoor and is a recipient of the Ati Vishisht Seva Medal and Vishisht Seva Medal.

national_news.title: Government Reduces Sugar Stock Limit to 2,000 Quintals to Ensure Price Stability
bullets: The Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution reduced the stock holding limit for sugar dealers from 4,000 quintals to 2,000 quintals.
The new limit is effective from the 15th of the month until November 30th to curb hoarding, speculative trading, and ensure price stability.
Sugar dealers cannot hold stock exceeding 30 days from the date of receipt, while Kolkata and its extended metropolitan areas retain the 4,000 quintal limit.

national_news.title: Indian Forensic Team Assists in DNA Analysis for Flash Flood Victims in Nepal
bullets: A 19-member Indian forensic team began DNA analysis to help identify victims of recent flash floods in Nepal.
The analysis is being conducted at the Nepal Police Central Forensic Science Laboratory and the National Forensic Science Laboratory in Kathmandu.
The initiative supports Nepal in processing DNA samples from unclaimed bodies as the death toll and number of missing persons continue to rise.

national_news.title: INS Sudarshini Arrives in Barcelona for Lokayan 2026
bullets: Indian Navy's sail training ship INS Sudarshini arrived in Barcelona, Spain, as part of its ongoing transoceanic expedition, Lokayan 26.
The 10-month expedition commenced in January 2026, serving as a flagship voyage to showcase India's maritime traditions and naval excellence.
During the port call, the ship undertook professional interactions, seamanship exchanges, and cultural engagements with the Spanish Navy and local maritime stakeholders.

national_news.title: Ministry of Statistics Releases Updated GDP Series and Double Deflation Methodology Details
bullets: The Ministry of Statistics & Programme Implementation (MoSPI) released updated annual and quarterly GDP estimates with the base year 2022-23.
The updated series incorporates the Output Producer Price Index (PPI), Banking Services Price Index (BkSPI), and the double-deflation methodology.
MoSPI clarified that a negative implicit GVA deflator in sectors like manufacturing does not imply falling prices, but rather reflects input prices rising faster than output prices.

national_news.title: India Post Payments Bank Launches Digital Mutual Fund and Insurance Platforms
bullets: India Post Payments Bank (IPPB) launched digital platforms for mutual funds and insurance on its 9th Foundation Day.
The platforms provide customers access to mutual fund investments alongside life, health, and general insurance solutions.
As of March 2026, IPPB boasts 13.25 crore customers, with 77% located in rural areas, leveraging the massive network of nearly 1.65 lakh post offices.

national_news.title: Districts as Export Hubs (DEH) Initiative: Expanding India's Grassroots Exports
bullets: The Districts as Export Hubs (DEH) initiative transforms every district into a center of export planning by identifying local products and services with global potential.
Building upon the One District One Product (ODOP) concept, the DEH initiative covers more than 770 districts across India as of January 2026.
India's total exports of goods and services reached an estimated US$ 863.11 billion in 2025-26, driven by convergence frameworks under the Department of Commerce and DGFT.

national_news.title: Gujarat Media Delegation Visits CSIR-IIIM Jammu
bullets: A media delegation from Gujarat visited the CSIR-Indian Institute of Integrative Medicine (CSIR-IIIM) in Jammu under a PIB-coordinated tour.
Director Dr Zabeer Ahmed highlighted the institute's work in drug discovery, medicinal plants, and the Aroma Mission leading to the Purple Revolution.
The delegation explored research facilities, the BioNEST Incubator, and startup support ecosystems.

national_news.title: Civil Aviation Minister Hails Hub & Spoke Operations in Ahmedabad
bullets: Ahmedabad became the third airport in India after Varanasi and Amritsar to launch Hub & Spoke international flight operations.
The initiative allows seamless check-in, immigration clearance, and baggage check-through directly to international destinations from domestic origins.
The model supports the government's International Aviation Hub Strategy to make India a leading global aviation hub by 2047.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Flood Alert: Ganga River Water Level Rises in Patna and Other Districts
bullets: The Disaster Management Department issued an alert due to the continuous rise in the water level of the Ganga river across Patna and several other districts.
Water levels were projected to cross the Highest Flood Level at Gandhi Ghat in Patna and at Hathidah in Mokama.

Low-lying areas in Bhojpur, Patna, Saran, Vaishali, Nalanda, Begusarai, Lakhisarai, and Jehanabad were advised to remain alert, with the State Emergency Operation Centre accessible via helpline number 1070.

bihar_news.title: HUDCO Signs Rs 25,000 Crore MoU with Bihar Government for Industrial Infrastructure
bullets: Housing & Urban Development Corporation (HUDCO) signed an MoU with the Government of Bihar on September 2, 2026, in Patna to provide financial assistance up to Rs 25,000 crore over five years.

The funds will be disbursed as term loans for industrial infrastructure development, including land acquisition for proposed industrial parks implemented through the Infrastructure Development Authority (IDA).
Loans feature flexible terms with a moratorium and repayment period of up to 25 years, alongside prepayment options.

bihar_news.title: India's Record Wheat Harvest Opens $1.5 Billion Export Window
bullets: India's record wheat production reached 121 MMT in 2025-26 against domestic consumption of around 111 MMT.
The Central Pool stock stood at 51.3 MMT against the buffer norm of 27.5 MMT as of May 2026, driven by a policy shift moving wheat and related products from 'Prohibited' to 'Free' export status.
ASSOCHAM report highlights export opportunities worth over $1.5 billion targeting Egypt, Indonesia, Bangladesh, Algeria, and the Philippines due to competitive pricing.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Fisheries Department Advises Against Consuming Flood-Caught Fish
bullets: The Animal and Fisheries Resources Department of Bihar issued an advisory warning citizens not to consume fish caught from floodwaters.
Floodwaters expose fish to sewage, dead animals, and pathogens, raising health risks of bacterial and viral infections.
The advisory will remain in effect until floodwaters stabilize and water bodies return to normal conditions.

bihar_news.title: Severe Flood Situation Worsens Across Bihar as Major Rivers Rise
bullets: Rising water levels in the Ganga, Gandak, Kosi, and Son rivers have severely affected North, Central, and South Bihar.
Bhagalpur remains the worst-affected district, with floodwaters spreading into low-lying areas of Patna, Buxar, Khagaria, Samastipur, and Vaishali.
All 69 gates of the Indrapuri Barrage on the Son River were opened following heavy water release from the Bansagar Dam.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Launches 'Jaanch evam Upchar, Chikitsa Aapke Dwar' Healthcare Campaign
bullets: Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary inaugurated the 'Jaanch evam Upchar, Chikitsa Aapke Dwar' door-to-door healthcare campaign on September 2, 2026.

The campaign runs from September 2 to November 30 across all 38 districts, targeting around 6 crore people aged 30 and above to screen for non-communicable and serious diseases like diabetes, hypertension, cancer, and TB.
Over 63% of women in Bihar suffer from anaemia; the state plans to screen approximately 1 crore women and girls under this initiative and create digital health records linked with ABHA IDs.

bihar_news.title: CM Samrat Chaudhary Participates in Health Awareness Campaign Event in Patna
bullets: CM Samrat Choudhary and Health Minister Nishant Kumar participated in the health awareness campaign and mobile awareness vehicle event held at Urja Auditorium in Patna.
The event was organized as part of the state-wide healthcare drive aimed at improving early diagnosis and treatment access for major diseases.
Awareness chariots were flagged off to travel across villages and communities to spread preventive healthcare information.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Identifies Over 8 Lakh Manuscripts for Digitisation Under Gyan Bharatam Mission
bullets: Bihar has identified over 8 lakh rare palm-leaf and paper manuscripts across all 38 districts for digitisation under the central Gyan Bharatam Mission.
An administrative approval of Rs 6.23 crore was granted to accelerate conservation, and AI tools are being deployed to transliterate Brahmi and Kaithi scripts into Hindi and English.
The state also announced plans for a National School of Drama (NSD) campus near Patna and reported strong registration on its dedicated film portal under the Bihar Film Promotion Policy.

bihar_news.title: Patna High Court Directs Bihar Authorities to Grant Family Pension to Second Wife
bullets: The Patna High Court, in a verdict delivered by Justice Purnendu Singh on August 25, 2026, set aside a 2019 state government order denying family pension to the second wife of a deceased departmental clerk.

The court noted that the employee had submitted a formal application for marriage permission back on February 28, 1982, under Rule 23(2) of the Bihar Government Service Conduct Rules, 1976, which the administration had improperly ignored.
The court ruled that denying spousal status after decades of cohabitation and raising six children is unjust and unsustainable.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Power Minister Highlights Solar Plan and Smart Meters at Bharat Electricity 2026
bullets: Bihar Power Minister announced that over 94 lakh smart prepaid meters have been installed, reducing AT&C losses from 60% to 11.54%.
The state touched a record peak power demand of 9,475 MW, projected to reach 19,033 MW by FY 2037.
An upcoming scheme will provide free 1.1 kW rooftop solar systems to 2.5 lakh Below Poverty Line (BPL) families, alongside a 1,200 MW Pumped Storage Plant in Nawada.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Chief Minister Inaugurates First Phase of Patna Flyover
bullets: The first phase of the Karbigahiya-Mithapur flyover and the 2.1 km Mithapur-Sipara elevated road in Patna was inaugurated to ease traffic congestion.
The Karbigahiya-Mithapur flyover project was constructed at a cost of Rs 2.49 billion.
The infrastructure initiative aims to improve connectivity to the Patna railway station, Mithapur bus stand, and surrounding areas.

bihar_news.title: Indian Railways Clears Infrastructure Projects Worth Rs 630 Crore Across Three States
bullets: Indian Railways approved projects worth an estimated investment of Rs 630 crore across Gujarat, Bihar, and West Bengal.
Projects include a 272 INR-Crore bypass line between Adra and Joychandipahar in South Eastern Railway and an Electronic Interlocking system in Eastern Railway.
The initiatives aim to expand operational capacity, modernize signaling infrastructure, and improve freight movement across critical corridors.
